root_cause: The BG139 cache-first refactor successfully removed expensive direct Notion reads from the public webhook path, but it also removed the legacy BG139-to-BG188 equivalence handoff. Fallback responsibility moved to BG190, which writes SHADOW directly with a generic semantic hash instead of sending the fresh payload through BG188. This both stops normal equivalence-streak advancement and can overwrite the prior eq:<n> marker. BG191 therefore is not reliably reached at the required streak of 25. BG186 remains SHADOW, BG139 correctly refuses it, and repeated polling continues to pay fallback cost.
